body:
Relevant section introduced in #99374 and untouched since then. 
(So not a regression, but a bug that has been in since it's addition.)

I did some digging and I found some interesting stuff:

Due to the line/typo mentioned above the default_theme never actually sets the ColorPresetButton's focus_style. This doesn't throw an error because ColorPicker is a valid theme_type, just not the one we intended to change. 

So what is actually rendered? ~~The correct thing!
As far as I can tell Control.get_theme_stylebox ends up asking the parent (aka. the ColorPicker) for the style, which returns the erroneously assigned style right back, making it work correctly!~~ (Update: after further investigation I'm not sure.)

But, if you then try to edit a new theme, the "preset_focus" option is missing, and overriding it manually seems to do nothing.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8115a223-b5f8-41c6-9834-1abe42be6a02)
 (I expect "preset_focus" to show up here.)

If I change the line to what it should be: `theme->set_stylebox("preset_focus", "ColorPresetButton", focus); `
~~the visuals look the same~~ The focus actually shows up and I regain the ability to correctly adjust the preset_focus.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c8eb8766-42ea-41c9-bed8-fe273ab816e7)

I'll open a pr.
Thanks for checking! Nice to hear that your fix allows users to theme this style properly now, while not causing any visual regressions.

Update issue description from my findings: 
( @AThousandShips, let me know if updating it like this is fine or if I should put this in a new issue) 

### Tested versions
- master (46c495ca2)

### System information

`Godot v4.5.beta (46c495ca2) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7270) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900HX (32 threads) - 47.72 GiB memory`

### Issue description

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b0e0b3e-fdcf-4736-ac95-db9f90cf361d)

Unable to change "preset_focus" style of ColorPresetButton in Theme.
"preset_focus" does not show up in the theme override list. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/59817f24-8895-4b9c-a7bb-f1659fdc83fb)

Also manually changing the "preset_focus", by adding it explicitly does nothing. 

###  Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new Theme
2. Add ColorPresetButton
3. Notice "preset_focus" is not displayed in the stylebox tab, also after using "override all"
4. Try manually adding "preset_focus" and changing it.
5. Notice how this does not affect behaviour
